description: Contrary to the painting's title, the artist, Charles Sheeler, depicted himself here ignoring the brightly lit landscape in front of him. Rather than illustrating the rolling greenery, massive stone walls, stairs, and pathways of the composition, the figure works intently on a monochromatic drawing of an antiquated stove, which is based on one of Sheeler’s own photographs from 1917.
title: The Artist Looks at Nature
